spans.s: इषः [iṣḥ], 1 One possessed of sap or strength.
इषणयते [iṣaṇayatē], Den. A. To move, excite; इयानास इषणयन्त धीभिः
इषण्यति [iṣaṇyati], Den. P. To excite, drive, urge on; ऋतस्य बुध्न उषसामिषण्यन्
इषण्या [iṣaṇyā], Impulse, desire; इषण्यया नः पुरुरूपमाभर
Owning, possessing, sharing, master or lord of; see below.
One who is completely master of anything.
शः A lord, master; with gen. or in comp.; कथंचिदीशा मनसां बभूवुः
with great difficulty controlled (were masters of) their minds; so वागीश, सुरेश &c.
The number 11 (derived from the eleven Rudras).
N. of Śiva (as regent of the north-east quarter.
The Supreme god (परमेश्वर); व्यक्ताव्यक्तं भरते विश्वमीश- मीड्यम् Śevt.
शा Supremacy, power, dominion, greatness. Śvet.
A woman having supremacy; a rich lady.-Comp. -कान्तः A class of the eleven-storeyed buildings. (Mānasāra 2
). -कोणः the north-east quarter. -गीता f. N. of a section of the Kūrma Purāṇa. -दण्डः Axle-pole or a car. -पुरी, -नगरी N. of Benares. -बलम् the missile पाशुपत. -सखः an epithet of Kubera.
The pole or shafts of a carriage or a plough. ईषा चक्रादिसंनिधाने चेदक्षमानयेत्युच्यते तदा यानाक्षमधि- कृत्य ब्रूते
A part of a chariot. -षे (du.) The double or fork-shaped pole. -Comp. -दण्डः the handle of a plough; ईषादण्डौ मृत्युशय्यातलस्य Śi.18.43. -दन्त a. with projecting teeth.
(न्तः) an elephant with a large tusk or tooth.
the handle of a plough; ईषादन्तः कुञ्जरं शात्रवीयम् Śi.18.38.
नः A ruler, master, lord; ईशानो भूतभव्यस्य Kaṭh.
The sun as a form of Śiva. पर्जन्यो यमो मृत्युरीशानः Bṛi.
N. of Viṣṇu. -नी N. of Durgā. -नी, -नः The silk-cotton tree (शाल्मली; Mar. सांवरी). -नम् Light, splendour. -Comp. -आदिपञ्चमूर्तिःf. one of the five forms of Śiva. -कल्पः N. of a Kalpa.-कृत् a.
making one a master or able.
ईशावास्यम् [īśāvāsyam], N. of the ईशावास्योपनिषद्, also called ईशोप- निषद्; the only instance of an upaniṣad included in a Saṁhitā (
ईषण [īṣaṇa] ईषणिन् [īṣaṇin], ईषणिन् a. Hastening. -णा Haste, speed.
Slightly, to some extent, a little; ईषत् चुम्बितानि Ś.1.4; ईषच्च कुरुते सेवाम्
. Easily done, with very little exertion; ईषत्कार्यमिदं कार्यं कृतमासीन्न संशयः
. -Comp. -उष्ण a. tepid, slightly warm. -ऊन a. not quite complete, a little less than; ईषदूनार्धे कल्पप्. -कर a.
. (-रम्) very little.-कार्य a. very easy, connected with slight effort; ईषत्कार्यो वधस्तस्य

. -गुण a. of little merit. -जलम् shallow water, a little water. -दर्शनम् a glance, sight, view, glimpse. -दीर्घः An almond. -नाद a. slightly sounding (a term applied to unaspirated soft consonants). -निमय a. exchanged for a little. -पाण्डु a. a little white or pale, whitish. (-ण्डुः) a pale or light-brown colour. -पान a. that of which a little is drunk. ईषत्पानः सोमो भवता Sk. आनोयुच्
. (-नम्) a small draught. -पुरुषः a mean or contemptible person. -बीजा Quince-seed, Dyrus Cydonia (Mar. वेदाणा). -रक्त a. pale red.

undistinguishable colour. -लभ, -प्रलम्भ a. to be got for little. -विवृत a. slightly open. -वीर्यः Almond tree. -श्वास a. slightly resounding. -स्पृष्ट a. slightly touched (applied to the semivowels) ईषत्स्पृष्टमन्तस्थानम् Sk. -हासः slight laughter, a smile.
ईसराफः [īsarāphḥ], N. of the fourth yoga in Astrology.
